scenes.text: This tutorial covers Classify, machine learning. Train feature-based classifiers such as XGBoost or random forest from measured single-object data.
Open Classify, machine learning from the Core section. Choose a measurements database, label column, feature families, and experimental grouping columns.
In the main configuration area, configure filtering, scaling, feature selection, class balancing, model family, and leakage-safe splits.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. cross-validate model choices and reserve a held-out evaluation set when possible.
When the workflow finishes, the project receives predictions, feature importance, performance tables, and serialized models.
